description:
## Finding

JMAP-x2gd.91 fixed the two backend Display leak sites in
`crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs` (duplicate-Direct cleanup
failure) and `crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs` (burn-on-read
hard-delete failure) by routing through
`server_fail_value_from_backend`. The redaction discipline is
restored mechanically.

A regression test was NOT added in the .91 fix commit. The
mail-server canary pattern at
`crate-jmap-mail-server/tests/integration.rs:5746-5818` is the
target shape: inject a backend that returns a canary literal in
its Display, drive the failure path, assert the wire-format
description equals `SERVER_FAIL_INTERNAL_DESC` and the canary
does NOT appear anywhere in the wire response.

## Blocker

Chat-server's FaultyBackend (`tests/common/mod.rs:38-107`) is
simpler than mail-server's: it has no `inject(type, op)`
selective-failure mechanism. Either the chat-server FaultyBackend
needs to grow that mechanism (canonical-template-shaped change to
match mail-server), or both tests need a bespoke wrapper that
selectively fails `destroy_object<Chat>` (for chat.rs) and
`expire_message` (for message.rs) while letting the setup writes
succeed.

## Fix shape

1. Extend `FaultyBackend` (or add a sibling `InjectableBackend`)
   with a per-(type, op) injection mechanism mirroring
   mail-server's pattern.
2. Add two `#[tokio::test]` cases mirroring the mail-server
   shape: one drives a Chat/set create that triggers the
   duplicate-Direct cleanup failure; one drives a Message/set
   update with burn-on-read that triggers expire_message failure.
3. Both tests assert the canary literal does NOT appear in the
   wire response and the description equals
   `SERVER_FAIL_INTERNAL_DESC`.

## Priority rationale

P3 not P1: the leak is already closed at both sites by the .91
fix commit. The missing test is a regression guard, not a live
defect. The mechanical fix is identical to the helper used at
~115 other sites (calendars / mail / contacts / etc.) which DO
have canary coverage, so the pattern itself is already
test-pinned at the workspace level — just not at the chat-server
sites.
title: Add chat-server-local canary tests for redaction at duplicate-Direct-cleanup and burn-on-read failure paths
